Anna hopes to visit Rome one day. The birthday party is one of the best places in the city. Last Tuesday, Anna and Mia went to the birthday party. Also, my hometown is famous for its beautiful lake.
Anna learned a lot about science. Mia is interested in dancing. Anna is reading a book about science. Also, the store sells ice cream in every flavour imaginable.
Anna and Mia had great fun there. Life is full of small surprises. Anna's favorite animal is the rabbit. Also, a friend request from a stranger popped up.
It takes twenty minutes to get to the birthday party by bike. They took many photos at the class meeting. Anna is going to travel to Rome in September.
